# Generated site data review

## Status

`generated-site-data-review.yml` is a dormant, manual-only review path. It is
not called by `main.yml`, does not deploy the site, and does not change the
current preprocessing or deployment behavior. Missing configuration fails
closed. Cutting `main.yml` over to this path requires a later, separately
reviewed change.

## What a bounded run does

1. An operator manually dispatches the workflow on a branch while repository
   variable `GENERATED_SITE_DATA_REVIEW_ENABLED` is exactly `true`.
2. A read-only GitHub-hosted Arm64 job checks out the dispatch commit, runs the
   three existing preprocessing scripts with Python 3.11 and a hash-locked
   Arm64 PyYAML wheel, and permits changes only to:
   `data/category_data.yml`, `data/category_data_windows.yml`, and
   `data/recently_added_packages.yaml`.
3. The job creates a deterministic ZIP. Its canonical manifest binds the exact
   base commit, file paths, sizes, and SHA-256 digests. The archive SHA-256 is
   passed independently to the publication job.
4. A separate job enters protected environment `generated-data-delivery`,
   checks out the same base commit without persisted credentials, downloads the
   exact run artifact, and validates its structure and every digest before
   restoring only the three allowlisted files.
5. Only after validation succeeds, the job mints a short-lived repository-scoped
   Dashboard Delivery GitHub App token, reverifies every generated byte against
   the artifact, and invokes the generated-data publisher. The publisher may
   update its deterministic automation branch and open a draft PR. It cannot
   approve, merge, deploy, or write the base branch.

All jobs use `ubuntu-24.04-arm`. The workflow contains no AWS credential use,
Hugo build or deploy, personal access token, personal credential, direct
base-branch push, or automatic merge.

## Required configuration

Keep `GENERATED_SITE_DATA_REVIEW_ENABLED=false` until a bounded run is approved.
For an approved review run, configure:

- Repository variable `DASHBOARD_DELIVERY_APP_BOT_LOGIN`: exact installed App
  bot login ending in `[bot]`.
- Protected environment `generated-data-delivery`: required independent
  reviewers, self-review prevention, and no administrator bypass.
- Environment secret `DASHBOARD_DELIVERY_APP_ID`: numeric App ID.
- Environment secret `DASHBOARD_DELIVERY_APP_PRIVATE_KEY`: the App private key.

Install the Dashboard Delivery App only on the target repository. Its repository
permissions are Metadata read, Contents read/write, Pull requests read/write,
and Workflows read/write. It needs no Actions, Issues, Administration, Secrets,
Environments, or organization permission. Do not substitute a PAT or personal
token. The broader Workflows permission supports separately reviewed package
onboarding changes; this site-data workflow downscopes its token to Metadata,
Contents, and Pull requests because it never edits workflow files.

After a bounded run, immediately return
`GENERATED_SITE_DATA_REVIEW_ENABLED=false`. Review the draft PR normally; this
workflow never approves or merges it. A later production cutover must remove the
direct generated-data write from `main.yml` and wire deployment to independently
reviewed merged data in a separate PR.
